'''Pest-control droids''' were a class of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tyed Kant]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were armed with [[Insecticide/Legends|insecticide]] spray and [[clipping shears]], and were capable of maneuvering through the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant's]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. Three droids infected by the [[Mynock virus]] malfunctioned and attacked a peaceful [[iagoin]].
